title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does Instead of Chasing a Wife
caption:
9 things a godly man does instead of chasing a wife he doesn't have yet (and doesn't need yet).

The 6 a.m. gym session no one's there to see. The Bible open before the phone is. The sin he's still killing, alone, before he brings anyone into it.

Seek first the kingdom of God, and everything else gets added (Matthew 6:33).

Wanting a wife was never the problem. Needing her to feel whole is.

#faith #scripture #christianmen #manofgod #singleness
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
